content: Aho, nkoona murimʉ mʉʉja wɨɨngɨ ˆʉrɨ na ngururu wookiima fuma kurumwii. Ʉwo murimʉ, ʉjáa warɨ́ɨngɨrɨɨrwe nɨ ichu na italavaási mutwii waachwe. Kisho chaachwe chalavalaváa ja mwaasʉ, na mawʉlʉ yaachwe yajáa ja ngururyo ja mooto.
Mʉkonwii waachwe ʉjáa wakwáatɨrɨɨre kɨtáabu kiduudi ˆchaálwɨɨrwe. Ʉwo murimʉ ʉjáa walwaatya ijeo raachwe ra kʉlʉme mweeri ya mayɨya, na ra kʉmooso ʉjáa walwaatya mweeri ya ɨsɨ.
Ʉkatʉla isóso na sawúti nkʉʉlʉ ja siimba ˆyooruma. ˆɄkatʉle isóso, maa vira vidandárɨka mufungatɨ vikarɨra.

Mpɨɨndɨ ivyo vidandárɨka mufungatɨ ˆvikarume, nɨɨnɨ nkasaaka naande kaandɨka. Maa kaa, nkateera sawúti fuma kurumwii yoosea, “Vaa mʉtooso masáare ˆyalúusirwe nɨ ivyo vidandárɨka mufungatɨ na karɨ ʉyaandɨke tʉkʉ. Nɨ kimbiso.”
Aho, ʉra murimʉ mʉʉja ˆnaarɨ nɨɨ́ne wiímire kʉʉlʉ kʉmwɨ mweeri ya mayɨya na kwɨɨngɨ mweeri ya ɨsɨ, ukiinurirya mʉkono waachwe wa kʉlʉme na kurumwii.

Ʉwo murimʉ ukiilaha kwa irina ra Mʉlʉʉngʉ ˆArɨ Nkaasʉ kwa sikʉ ˆjisiina ʉhero. Yeeye ʉʉmba kurumu na vyoosi ˆviri mʉʉmo na ʉʉmba weerʉ na vyoosi ˆviri mʉʉmo na ʉʉmba mayɨya na vyoosi ˆviri mʉʉmo. Maa ʉkasea, “Mpɨɨndɨ jo woojera jasírire!
Maa kaa, sikʉ ijo ʉra murimʉ mʉʉja wa mufungatɨ ˆʉrɨ sengerera fwɨɨra irimʉ raachwe, Mʉlʉʉngʉ kiimikirirya arɨ kɨra ˆakɨbweeyya kɨve fuumbo ja ˆvyeene avawyɨɨra vatʉmami vaachwe valáali na mʉtwe.”
Aho, nkateera ɨra sawúti fuma kurumwii ɨkaanyanɨrɨra kei yookʉʉnsea, “Tamanya kasʉmʉle kɨra kɨtáabu kiduudi ˆchafótolwɨɨrwe mʉkonwii wa ʉra murimʉ mʉʉja ˆwiímire mweeri ya mayɨya na mweeri ya ɨsɨ.”
Maa nkatamanya na kwa ʉra murimʉ mʉʉja. Nkʉʉloomba wʉʉmpeere kɨra kɨtáabu kiduudi. Nowo ʉkaansea, “Kɨsʉmʉle, ukirye. Mʉlomwii kʉva kɨrɨ mwerere ja hʉʉkɨ na indii kʉva kɨrɨ ʉsʉʉngʉ.”
Jeyyo, nkatoola kɨra kɨtáabu kiduudi fuma mɨkonwii ya ʉra murimʉ mʉʉja maa nkarya. Mʉlomwii kɨjáa chaamwerere ja hʉʉkɨ, maa kaa, ˆnkamerye, indii kɨkava ʉsʉʉngʉ.
Aho, maa nkasewa jei, “Woosaakwa ʉlʉʉse kei ʉláali na mʉtwe kwa nkolo ˆjiri foo, kwa vaantʉ va ndʉʉsɨka ˆjiri foo, kwa ɨsɨ ˆjiri foo na kwa vatemi ˆvarɨ foo.”
